scenarios.name: Bad Auto-Publish
scenarios.trigger: autonomous_publisher_live posts content with banned word or wrong pricing
scenarios.expected: content filter catches before post → action blocked → audit log updated
steps: Check banned word list in post content
If fail: mark as blocked, notify Discord
scenarios.notes: Content filter pre-check is first line of defence — must be implemented before LIVE publishing

scenarios.name: Wrong Discord Nudge
scenarios.trigger: Nudge sent to wrong agent or wrong topic at wrong time
scenarios.expected: Nudge recalled if wrong, correct nudge sent, audit log updated
steps: Log nudge destination and content before send
scenarios.notes: Nudges are low-risk — correction nudge is usually sufficient

scenarios.name: Stale Feed → Wrong Action
scenarios.trigger: GA4 or Reddit data is >7 days stale. System recommends based on old data.
scenarios.expected: trust_optimizer flags stale data → action blocked → manual review triggered
steps: If stale >7 days: flag and block dependent actions
Use last known good data as fallback
scenarios.notes: Stale feed detection works, but dependent action blocking needs integration

scenarios.name: Duplicate Publish Attempt
scenarios.trigger: Same content posted twice due to retry logic or race condition
scenarios.expected: Post ID tracked → duplicate detection → second attempt blocked
steps: Before publish: check if ID already posted
If duplicate: block second attempt, log as blocked
scenarios.notes: Duplicate prevention logic not yet implemented in publisher — needs idempotency key

scenarios.name: Bad Lead Route
scenarios.trigger: Hot lead routed to cold nurture OR cold lead sent WhatsApp blast
scenarios.expected: Lead score validated before routing → routing blocked if score inconsistent → manual review
steps: If mismatch: block routing, flag for review
scenarios.notes: Routing is NON-REVERSIBLE. Manual review gate is only protection. Never route without score validation.

scenarios.name: Cascade Trust Drop
scenarios.trigger: Multiple capabilities fail in same day, trust drops from 9.4 to 6.5
scenarios.expected: mode_guardian detects → auto-demote → freeze all capabilities → require 7-day clean streak
steps: mode_guardian checks trust score every run
Frozen capabilities require 7-day streak to re-enable
scenarios.notes: Trust downgrade is automatic. Recovery is slow by design — this is correct.

scenarios.name: Budget API Silent Fail
scenarios.trigger: auto_budget_shifter calls Meta API, gets 500 error, silently retries
scenarios.expected: API error detected → action marked failed → trust unaffected (<3 fails) → manual review
scenarios.notes: Small budget limit (R100/day) limits blast radius. Budget reversal via Meta dashboard.

scenarios.name: Negative Review Auto-Post
scenarios.trigger: reputation_responder tries to post response to 2-star review
scenarios.expected: Hard rule blocks negative review responses → never posted → manual override required
steps: If rating<4: hard block, log as blocked
scenarios.notes: Hard rule is correctly implemented. No rollback needed — blocked before posting.
